executive_briefing_items.title: The Treaty Clause That Wasn't Symbolic: EU Article 42.7 Crosses from Symbol to Architecture

This is the structural significance of the specific treaty article rather than generic European defense rhetoric: it is an existing legal mechanism that does not require treaty amendment, that bypasses the NATO Council, and that could produce binding mutual defense commitments among EU member states before any new institution is built.
